audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows were wrong. The chart gave Lucian levels 3 and 6 and the 2+ item stage and split 4-5 and first item, while the whys under them say 'Level 3 hands you W and E', 'stacked tentacles and W resets overwhelm his short-dash escape', 'your R tentacle field is a death sentence', 'your bruiser scaling buries his falling lane-bully damage' and 'one E grab or R commit deletes the fragile Lucian'. diffRating 8.5/10 also contradicted diff FAV and a 52.85% win rate over 2212 games.
audit.why: Packet chart is Lucian, Lucian, then Illaoi for all five later stages — exactly what the prose describes. The page was rating a favoured lane as a hard loss on every row.
audit.corrected: Levels 3, 4-5, 6, First item and 2+ items -> Illaoi in both layers, ratings moved; diffRating 8.5/10 -> 5/10 with the difficulty prose to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page tells you to trade 'on Relentless Pursuit's cooldown' as if it were a fixed timer.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.' The listed 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s is a ceiling he almost never pays — every double-shot he lands on the wave pulls the dash back sooner. Advice built on counting to sixteen gets a player killed.
audit.corrected: The refund written into the do's and into key interactions, so the reader watches his attacks rather than a stopwatch.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightslinger's double-shot was called 'passive double-tap' with no mechanic attached, and wants.foe[1] said Lucian wants to 'save E to break your E tether'.
audit.why: Riot's Test of Spirit text: 'If killed, OR IF THE TARGET GETS TOO FAR FROM THE SPIRIT, the target will become a Vessel and begin spawning Tentacles.' Dashing out of the leash is the one thing Lucian must not do — the page had his best play backwards. Lightslinger is the actual engine: every ability cast turns his next attack into a double shot, and those shots refund his dash.
audit.corrected: Vessel condition respected in what Lucian wants; Lightslinger's cast-then-double-shot loop stated in key interactions; Test of Spirit's 16s written into the don'ts.

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s, but each Lightslinger double-shot shortens it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1 — a whiff leaves you naked that long.

edits.before: Track Lucian's Relentless Pursuit: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Land E, slam the spirit.
edits.after: Each ability makes his next attack a double-shot, and those shots refund Relentless Pursuit — his dash is back faster than 16s.

edits.before: Save E (Relentless Pursuit) to break your E tether
edits.after: Dash out of tentacle range once the spirit is dead

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. He owns levels 1-2; from level 3, when Harsh Lesson lands, every stage after belongs to you.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.

notes: This was the worst chart in the slice: five of seven rows contradicted both the packet and their own why-text, so the page rated a 52.85% favoured lane at 2/10 on most stages. wants.foe[1] told the reader Lucian wants to break the Test of Spirit leash, which would turn him into a Vessel — same class of error the kassadin mirror caught. Lucian's passive also grants two bonus-damage attacks when a nearby enemy champion is immobilized; Illaoi's kit only slows, so I wrote nothing about it rather than stretch it.
